paths.name: node:path
paths.message: Use `pathe`, which returns `/`-separated paths on every platform, so separators never need rewriting by hand. Keep `node:path` only where a value must stay platform-native (`sep`, `delimiter`, `win32`, `posix`, or comparisons with native paths from fs, glob or webpack), and state that reason in the disable comment.
